verdict.rationale: The evidence points to official Stripe SDKs only indirectly. The versioning docs mention pinning an API version via the SDK, llms.txt tells agents to install Stripe packages from npm, and the official OpenAPI repo ships SDK spec variants. No first-party SDK page, language list or Billing-specific SDK usage is in the pack. Missing for 10: dedicated official SDK documentation, the list of supported languages, Billing-specific SDK examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Requests pin a version via the Stripe-Version header or SDK pinning
